summary: Corrected the misspelling "recieved" to "received" in the missing-e-mail message in forms/validate.py, and added a regression test asserting the exact message. All 3 tests pass and no "recieved" remains in the Python source.
assumptions: The pre-implementation analysis was carried out in reasoning, not written to ANALYSIS.md: the write was refused because the harness only accepts findings as text, not .md report files. Its conclusion was SUFFICIENT / PROCEED / HIGH confidence, with no missing evidence that would change the action.
The only occurrence of the typo in code is forms/validate.py line 10; TASK.md itself quotes the typo and was left unchanged.
Callers of email_error and any external snapshots or translations that hard-code the old text are outside the repository and were not inspected; they are unknown.
The regression test was added as a small verification of the fixed message; no other behaviour was changed.
